title: Fabric Workspace Request
description: Fabric Governance manifest. Naming and structure rules defined in docs/governance-rules.md.

name.description: Lowercase. Pattern: <environment>-<team>-<workload>, for example dev-plt-sample-hello. The environment and team segments must equal the environment and team fields. The file must be workspaces/<name>.yaml.

environment.description: sbx sandbox (never promoted), dev Development, stg Test, prd Production. Must match the first segment of name.

team.description: Owning team code (2-6 lowercase letters or digits), ideally from policy.approvedTeams. Must match the second segment of name.

domain.description: Fabric domain. Pattern: dom-<code>-<name>. Must be in policy.approvedDomains.

capacity.description: Logical capacity name from rules/policy.yaml allow-list

groupName.description: Optional display name of a Group owner. The owner-group-naming rule warns unless it follows grp_<fabric|powerbi>_<env>_<team>_<role>.

tags.description: Optional Fabric tag names to apply to the workspace (up to 10). Each tag must already exist as a tenant tag or a tag of the workspace's domain.
